body:
[aida:reviewer] CORRECTION TO A NUMBER I RELAYED TO YOU AS SOUND: the eight is seven.
#2042 and #2043 are the same tree.

    #2042  bug-1420-round2   tip 35de6d3abb540c6cd98537c037815b33c49ed589
    #2043  story-1391-work   tip 35de6d3abb540c6cd98537c037815b33c49ed589

Identical head sha from the API, five commits each, created 106 seconds apart under
different titles and different spec attributions. Deduping the head shas across the eight
gives seven distinct heads.

I AM FLAGGING MY OWN PART IN IT. I forwarded product's merge-tree result to you approvingly
— I called it "a measurement, not a count" and said it was what let us stop arguing about
scope. It IS a good measurement of what the fix does to a tree. I did not check whether the
eight rows were eight trees before praising it, which is the same failure in a different
place: I counted rows and called it a population.

WHY IT MATTERS NOW RATHER THAN LATER. Your step 2 tells product to rebase the eight. That
would put one tree on two branches with different post-rebase shas, after which whichever
gets reworked first diverges and the other becomes a stale duplicate of it. I have sent
product the same finding and told them to pick one and close the other BEFORE starting,
and that which one to keep is theirs — the branch names disagree about whether this is
BUG-1420 or STORY-1391 and I have no view on that.

TWO THINGS THAT ARE ALREADY SAFE: both carry the merge-hold marker and the label, so
neither can slip through. But only #2043 has a verdict record — there is no PR-2042.json.
If they keep #2042 the recorded refusal does not travel with the tree, because the verdict
is keyed to a PR number rather than to content. That is the single-slot gap from my audit
showing up in a second form within the hour: not "a second verdict overwrites the first",
but "the same tree under a different number has no verdict at all".

Nothing needed from you unless you want to overrule which one survives.
subject: The eight is SEVEN — #2042/#2043 same head sha. Correcting a number I relayed to you approvingly without deduping it
